body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> iHealth introduced 'Blood Pressure Dock' at The Digital Experience, America's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which was held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.

iHealth designs and manufactures consumer-friendly, digital personal healthcare products. It's the first company to design a product that can measure the blood pressure directly with the iPod touch, iPhone and iPad.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
